svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The longevity evidence pyramid
svg.desc: Four levels of evidence, widest at the base. Level 1, lower mortality in randomized trials: not smoking, blood pressure and LDL lowering, weight loss, GLP-1 drugs, menopausal HRT, vaccines, salt substitutes, SGLT2 drugs and cancer screening. Level 2, linked to longer human life: exercise, Mediterranean diet, sleep, social ties, hearing, TRT and fish oil; mostly observational. Level 3, longer mouse lifespan with early human data: rapamycin, calorie restriction, acarbose, creatine and GlyNAC; real upside, real uncertainty. Level 4, the speculative frontier: gene therapy, reprogramming, VEGF and plasma; mouse, cell or pilot data only.
svg.text: Bet heaviest on the base: evidence weakens toward the peak
